reviews.t: If you like dramatic lashes, these are it.
reviews.x: I LOVE these lashes. I was always intimidated by putting on thick long lashes, but since I love dramatic eye looks, I went for it! They are fluffy and soft and don’t feel plasticy. I was able to cut the band to fit my eye shape, and I use House of Lashes glue for these. They are so beautiful, I get complements on them every time I wear them.

Had to write a review for these. I paid 40.00 for mink lashes that didn’t curl up and whisp like tbese! Literally in full blow. Love with them! Although they are very dramatic, they still have a very natural feel to them. The band is flexible and easy to mold for beginners! Instantly my favorite lashes so far!

claims.text: Reviewers frequently describe the lashes as beautiful, gorgeous, and perfect, with many saying they get lots of compliments.
Many reviewers highlight that the lashes are dramatic, full, and very long, which some find too much and trim or pluck to adjust.
Several reviewers note the lashes are lightweight and long-lasting, with multiple uses or months of wear.
Some reviewers mention needing to cut or trim the lashes to fit their eye shape, and that doing so makes a big difference.
Multiple reviewers say they would recommend the lashes and plan to repurchase.
